versions.changelog:
- Added a new explicit checklist item: "Did I use any banned phrases that undermine my credibility? (See BANNED PHRASES section below)" to the pre-action checklist.
- Increased the pre-action checklist from 7 to 8 required checks before any action.
- Removed the file skill-card.md as part of simplification.

Initial release — establishes strict universal behavioral protocols for all agents in Donald's system:

- Adds Correction Response Gate: formal protocol for handling Donald's corrections, including proposal-approval-execution flow and mandatory validation.
- Implements mandatory Time Awareness gate: requires checking session status and calculating accurate ET/greeting before every action.
- Defines a 7-point Pre-Action Checklist to prevent redundant work, ensure safety, and verify context before proceeding.
- Introduces a Mistake Prevention Gate: cross-references lessons learned with incoming requests to avoid repeat errors.
- Creates a comprehensive Learning Loop: logs lessons in LESSONS.md, enforces write-time deduplication, and escalates recurring issues to mechanical gates.
- Adds a Mistake Loop Breaker protocol to identify and stop repetitive failures before involving Donald.
- Mandates evidence-based reporting on completions (Test-Before-Announce).
- Requires an explicit business outcome statement at the start of every task.
